searchText: re: BLS g1/g2 MSM gas pricing, I heard from <@905058765022310460> on the testing call this morning there had been some agreement about this at devcon? Is there a new proposal or consensus on what these should be? Talking with <@758579010027782144> it would good to get these changes in ahead of the next devnet As far as Gary and I remember, we planned to double the gas costs for g1/g2 msm. Also, still there were open questions about including, not including, or making optional the subgroup checks. I am happy to defer to the cryptographers and/or potential users of the curve - just looking for clarity on what we intend to deliver. 👍 for doubling g1/g2 msm costs from Geth side My favorite proposal is to keep the discount table as-is and adjust the multiplication factors for G1/G2 msm separately, to bring the gas costs across all the inputs in-line with ecrecover. The current discount table makes for a fairly flat distribution of costs, they are just individually offset above and below compared to ecrecover. e.g. original discount table, with `multiplication_cost` of 29_000 for g1 msm and 40_000 for g2 msm.

excerpts.content: As far as Gary and I remember, we planned to double the gas costs for g1/g2 msm.

excerpts.author: suburbandad_
excerpts.content: Also, still there were open questions about including, not including, or making optional the subgroup checks.  I am happy to defer to the cryptographers and/or potential users of the curve - just looking for clarity on what we intend to deliver.

excerpts.author: jwasinger
excerpts.content: 👍 for doubling g1/g2 msm costs from Geth side

excerpts.author: suburbandad_
excerpts.content:
My favorite proposal is to keep the discount table as-is and adjust the multiplication factors for G1/G2 msm separately, to bring the gas costs across all the inputs in-line with ecrecover.  The current discount table makes for a fairly flat distribution of costs, they are just individually offset above and below compared to ecrecover.

e.g. original discount table, with `multiplication_cost` of 29_000 for g1 msm and 40_000 for g2 msm.
